title: Golf Deckbuilding Roguelite - Watch a spooky hole from our game, the Arcane Open!
author: The_Arcane_Open
selftext:
Hi all! We're a four person indie dev team, and here is a hole from fantasy golf deckbuilding roguelike, The Arcane Open! It is a fantasy-inspired golf deckbuilder roguelite where you attempt to work your way through a three day tournament, building your deck and equipment along the way. Here is a sped-up hole from the Day 2 course, Hobb's Bend.

For those interested in receiving more updates, click [here](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5277960/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=organic) for the steam page! Also here is the discord link for [playtesters](https://discord.gg/qYdGV4hMu), as our demo is on Steam for playtesting.

Of course any feedback or questions are appreciated.
